title: Review workflow: build as the runner user into build-out
summary: The review workflow's build job no longer writes into the runner's checkout. It creates a `build-out` folder, runs the cargo build container as the runner's uid/gid with `CARGO_HOME` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` redirected into a writable `build-out` mount, and mounts the base checkout read-only. The work-item step and the artifact upload follow the binary to `build-out/target/release/osf`, and every job that mounts `out` writable now chmods it for the image user. A new integration test file pins these invariants: read-only `/base` mounts, writable `build-out`, runner-user containers, and no provider secrets in the build job.

nodes.summary: Builds the `osf` binary from the base branch with no cache, then runs the work-item command. Now creates `build-out`, runs both containers as the runner user, and reads the binary from `build-out/target/release/osf`.

nodes.label: review jobs
nodes.subtitle: out-mounting jobs

nodes.label: REVIEW_IMAGE

nodes.label: cargo build container

nodes.summary: Builds the base-branch binary. Mounts `base` read-only, mounts `build-out` writable, and points `CARGO_HOME` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` at `build-out` so no artifact lands in the checkout.

nodes.label: work-item container

nodes.label: base checkout
nodes.subtitle: /base:ro

nodes.label: build-out

nodes.label: out
nodes.subtitle: /out
nodes.summary: The review output folder mounted writable into the review jobs. Now chmodded `a+rwX` before the container runs so the image user can write into it.
